Settings.languageHelp: Summaries are written in each article’s own language, whatever you choose here.

summaries.heading: Summaries
summaries.comparisonMode: Comparison mode: summarize every new save with all {count, number} models, to compare them on each article’s Compare page. Costs about {count, number} times as much.
summaries.allowance: This month you’ve used {share, number, percent} of your AI allowance for summaries and translations. It renews on {date}.
summaries.allowanceModels: Claude Haiku uses less of it for each summary, and Claude Opus more.

tokens.heading: Access tokens
tokens.intro: The {chrome} extension and the {apple} Shortcuts use a token to save to your account. Make one per device, so you can revoke one without touching the others.
tokens.revokeConfirm: Revoke “{name}”? Anything using it stops working.
tokens.newToken: New token for “{name}”. Copy it now: it won’t be shown again.

folders.heading: Folders
folders.empty: No folders yet. Choose or create one at the bottom of an article.
folders.deleteConfirm: Delete the folder “{name}”? Its articles stay in your library.

export.heading: Export
export.intro: Everything you saved, with the article text and every summary.

Settings.appearanceIntro: Colors and a font for reading. {system} follows your device’s light or dark mode. The choice is saved to your account, so every device you sign in on uses it, and the Aa button at the top of every page changes it while you read.
